items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: So anyhow, we got a job one time, Louie. We were advertising chickens for fries on Canal Street, see... We were battling on Canal Street. We had Fasola, me, and their beautiful, Decamelt, three of us, you know.

ctx.x: Nice boy too. He was playing with the rock. Rusty Pérez band. He was a singer in the kind of band. He had a finance company, he made his own Blanche Miller. He went to play the gig in Baton Rouge, you know, and he'd come back, he felt bad. Stopped at the motel, one of the motels up there, died in a heart attack. He was like, no. I was playing with his daddy, see. He was playing with his daddy, see. Oh, you know, talking about this guy, Henry Raymond. He had a picture here, one of those bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo…
What was it that Lowe used to say, Lowe Pramee, you said, play it pretty for the people?
